Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Reagan administration issues a formal apology to medical researcher whose study of AIDS transmission by casual contact were misrepresented in a Justice Department memo 2. Gay and Lesbian Alliance Against Defamation launches the 701 Club, a fundraiser to combat anti-gay groups 3. Miami Yellow Pages now allows terms gay, lesbian, homosexual in ads COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Jerry Falwell's newest phone number to prevent women getting abortions announced 5. Andy Humm on the gay voting block and supporting pro-gay candidates above other political concerns COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. CDC separates AIDS-positive homosexual IV drug user statistics from those of drug-free homosexuals, creating a better perspective of the statistics 7. Governor John Ashcroft of Missouri puts guidelines in place to protect persons with AIDS from discrimination in government employment 8. Washington State tells Frito Lay they must obey anti-discrimination laws when doing business in the state 9. California Secretary of State wins suit preventing Lyndon LaRouche group from supplying false information to voters on AIDS quarantine initiative 10. Howard Stern advocating violence to "cure" gays, number announced for viewers to flood phone lines COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 11. Sports Report, footage from the 10th Annual Gay Softball World Series 12. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with erotic performer, Casey Donovan, on proper condom use (repeat) 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Coverage of San Francisco's "Closet Ball," with clips from the drag competition COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Interview with hardcore porn director Christopher Rage COMMERCIAL: "Woman Talk" theater piece COMMERCIAL: Body Mate exercise equipment 3. Closing credits
